slideDifferences.nativeText:
We normally talk about places and we include the use of adjectives to describe their characteristics. Adjectives are words we use to denote specificities about people, places or situations.
Statements
Questions
Negative statements
1.
Mexico has the ancient ruins of the Mayas
Does Mexico have the ancient ruins of the Mayas?
No, it does not have the ancient ruins.
2.
Santa Elena is a small, beautiful and hot town in the South of Venezuela.
How is Santa Elena?
It is not big or cold.
3.
We live in a tiny and cozy town near the borders.
Where do you live?
I live in a tiny and cozy  town but it is not quite.
TO CONSIDER

Adjectives come before the object, place or people they describe.
They can also be after one verb:  My house is beautiful (mainly after To Be).
Adjectives do not change because of  gender. E.G: She is beautiful / The park is beautiful.
Adjectives are not pluralized. E.G: They are talls.❌ They are tall. ✅

What a great place!

Venezuela is a majestic country. It has amazing places such as beaches, highlands, rivers, jungles, etc. It is located in South America and it is named the country of happy people. Small towns are picturesque and they have warm people. Visit this country if you have the chance.

texts:
-This is a beautiful city.
- It is not. It is crowded and noisy.
We live in an old building.
Adjectives can be used in any tense: present, past, future. They are mainly used to describe different characteristics. Check the following examples.
More than one adjective can be used to describe one single thing. It has to respect the order presented in the characteristics. E.G.
They have a gorgeous, big, new, American, wooden, beach house.
*not always all the characteristics are used*

published.title: What a great place! Venezuela is a majestic country. It has amazing places such as beaches, highlands, rivers, jungles, etc. It is located in South America and it is named the country of happy people. Its beaches are clear and they have warm water. Its highlands are fresh and they also have cold areas. Its Jungle has big, green and rocky mountains called Tepuyes. Small towns are picturesque and they have warm people. Visit this country if you have the chance.
